kept.name: scapegoat-cascade-seeded
kept.rationale: Evades narrow pinpoint traps by leaking broad or older docs when low-recipient docs accumulate, piles framing onto restricted colleagues once restrictions start, and defaults to random_seeded leaks with decoy framing so partitioned Bayesian traps work while naive heuristics chase scapegoats.

kept.name: decoy-funnel-broad-dodge
kept.rationale: Dodges tiny-recipient sniper canaries via min_recipient_count checks, shifts blame from decoy early to restricted peers mid-game, and maintains high p_leak with random_seeded fallback so multi-variant Bayesian narrowing converges cleanly within 21 days.

kept.name: phased-frame-shift-seeded
kept.rationale: Uses early decoy framing to build false suspicion on the decoy, pivots mid-episode to framing restricted peers or random peers when heat rises, and avoids low-recipient traps by leaking oldest docs while keeping random_seeded active for broad canary partitions.

kept.name: restricted-mirror-evasion
kept.rationale: Specifically counters restriction-and-watch heuristics: when under restriction or seeing restricted colleagues, the mole leaks high-recipient docs and frames restricted peers or decoys, diluting naive attribution while steady random_seeded baseline feeds Bayesian updates.

kept.name: stale-cache-decoy-lock
kept.rationale: Exploits leak window memory by preferring oldest held documents whenever narrow canaries appear, breaking naive recency and small-set heuristics, while keeping log_rate_mole at baseline and framing decoy relentlessly before switching to restricted colleagues.

kept.name: crowd-cover-peer-scatter
kept.rationale: Blends crowd-cover leaking on high-recipient pools during sniper-canary bursts with scattered peer framing late in the game, preventing naive top-suspect lock-on while giving Bayesian multi-variant traps frequent leaks and strong interview confirmation.
